Product Details: Freeman’s all-new 2nd Generation 10.5-Gauge 1-9/16" Fencing Stapler has been completely redesigned with contractors' needs in mind. Re-engineered internal components, top of the line features, and enhanced driving power make this fencing stapler more powerful and reliable than ever before. Compatible with 10.5 gauge glue collated fencing staples from 7/8" to 1-9/16", this pneumatic stapler delivers high-quality performance for your next hog and cattle fencing, pet enclosure, deer prevention, vineyard trellising, snow control fencing, electrified single wire with insulation, and other mesh and woven projects. Lightweight and resistant to damage, this nailer stands up to the toughest jobs thanks to the magnesium body, one piece hardened steel drive blade, and scratch-resistant powder coating. Optimized airflow and upgraded internal parts provide increased power with less air consumption, while also allowing for quick and easy repairs. Designed for maximum comfort and ease of use, this stapler features an updated textured grip, adjustable metal belt hook, wire-alignment notch to ensure accurate fastener placement, select fire trigger to easily switch between bump and sequential modes, easily adjustable depth for various applications, and a quick release nose for easy jam clearing. The Freeman 2nd Generation 10.5-Gauge 1-9/16" Fencing Stapler is backed by an industry-leading 7 Year Professional Warranty and 90 Day Wearable Parts Warranty, and comes with a 1/4" NPT connector, air tool oil, and adjustment tools.
